leftEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
leftEvidence.title: The men survey the land and return with its fruit

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: The men travel from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, go through the Negev, and reach Hebron and the valley of Eshcol.
points.right: The men return to Moses, Aaron, and the assembly, show the fruit, and say the land flows with milk and honey.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: They cut a grape cluster carried on a pole with pomegranates and figs, then return after forty days.
points.right: They also name strong people, fortified cities, descendants of Anak, and peoples occupying each region.

payload.posture: The survey records route, inhabitants, fruit, and forty days; the first report presents the land’s fruit and fortified resistance.

rightEvidence.role: The mission and the divided report
rightEvidence.title: The twelve agree about the fruit and the strength of the inhabitants

payload.tension: Shared evidence precedes the later division over what Israel can do.
payload.title: What the men see and what they report together
